headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ may take states’ voter-roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, Attorney General Todd Blanche says "absolutely it's a possibility" that the Department of Justice may take the Trump administration's fight over voter rolls to the Supreme Court.

headlines.title: Former MLB pitcher Tommy John dies at age 83
headlines.description: Tommy John, the longtime Major League baseball pitcher whose name is forever linked to the groundbreaking elbow surgery that saved his career and those of countless others since, has died, officials said Sunday.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche says FBI will continue providing assistance on Nancy Guthrie investigation but doesn’t yet have any updates
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche said that he doesn’t believe it would be the best course of action for the FBI to take over the investigation into the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie in Arizona

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: Rep. Ro Khanna called for a “Data Center Bill of Rights,” arguing that data centers needed to be regulated so local communities have a larger say on where to build them.

headlines.title: Novak Djokovic reveals unspecified health issue following ouster at the Cincinnati Open
headlines.description: Tennis star Novak Djokovic alluded to a health condition after an early exit from the Cincinnati Open on Saturday, in which he lost to 25-year-old Thiago Agustín Tirante in the second round.

headlines.title: 1 killed, 4 others wounded in Lexington, Kentucky, shooting
headlines.description: Five people were shot, one fatally, during summer festivities at a downtown Lexington, Kentucky, park on Saturday evening, according to police.

headlines.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ may take states’ voter roll fight to Supreme Court
headlines.description: Todd Blanche said there’s a “possibility” that the Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to rule on cases where the federal government’s is attempting to gain access to state voter rolls ahead of November’s midterm elections.
